title: Domain pack manifest
description: Declares everything that is domain-specific about one OAH pipeline run. Extracted from the sixteen places the GenAI domain was hardwired into pipeline core (see docs/decisions/011). Pipeline core reads this manifest instead of holding literals: surface-point vocabulary, S1 registries, kind->dimension mapping, lens roster, semconv namespaces, DTO event types, and the advisory-gate lexicon. A pack is data (domains/<name>/pack.json) plus, where a detector needs real logic rather than a constructor/method-suffix match, code under oah/domains/<name>/. Adding a domain must not require editing oah/cli.py, oah/design/gates.py, or any schema under schemas/.

name.description: Pack identifier, e.g. 'genai' or 'service'. Matches the directory name under domains/.

point_kinds.description: The surface_map.json point kinds this pack owns. Replaces the closed enum at surface_map.schema.json:33. Core validates a point's kind against the union of loaded packs' vocabularies, not a literal list. A kind a pack does not list here is simply not this pack's -- it is not the same as a kind this pack names but cannot yet detect (see detected_by: declared_undetected).

dimension.description: Gap-model dimension this kind rolls up to. Replaces KIND_TO_DIMENSION in oah/discovery/gap_model.py and the closed enum at gap_model.schema.json:25.

rollout_rank.description: S8 ordering hint; replaces _DIMENSION_ROLLOUT_RANK in oah/design/dto_generator.py. Omitted means the existing default of 1.

detected_by.description: How S1 finds this kind. 'fixed_pass' is a language adapter's own hardcoded detector logic that isn't driven by a registries[] table entry or a structural_pattern content_signal -- e.g. E11-TS's declarative_registration (JSX <Route>, route-object arrays) and global_unimported_callee (bare fetch(...)) passes, which emit kind: declarative_route / http_client_call regardless of which pack is loaded. Declaring such a kind here is what makes an already-detected-but-previously-unowned point visible to S3's gap model, since gap_model.py's dimension lookup is pack-derived. 'declared_undetected' is honest vocabulary for a kind the pack names but cannot yet detect; core must report such kinds in run_manifest.json rather than let them look covered.

registries.description: S1 signature registries contributed by this pack. Two detector shapes exist today, and this array carries both: a receiver/method-suffix chain (sdk_module + constructor_names + method_suffixes, the shape oah/discovery/registry.py already used before extraction), and a structural content-signal match (content_signal + detector_name, the shape the tool_use-dispatch detector in oah/discovery/python_adapter.py used before extraction -- a comparison of some expression's attribute against a literal value, not a resolved receiver+method call). sdk_module must be unique across ALL loaded packs -- MODULE_TO_REGISTRY assumes it.

language.description: Which language adapter this registry entry is for. Omitted means 'python' -- every registry entry before E11-TS's TypeScript adapter landed was implicitly Python-only, so this default keeps every existing pack byte-identical. Domain and language are orthogonal: one pack can declare registries for the same SDK in more than one language (e.g. genai's Anthropic registry has both a python and a typescript entry, same method_suffixes, different sdk_module string) rather than needing a second manifest per language.

sdk_module.description: Required for receiver_method_suffix/module_function_call shapes; absent for structural_pattern (a content-signal match has no resolved import to key on).

detector_shape.description: Which detection mechanism the language adapter must run. receiver_method_suffix and module_function_call are both driven by constructor_names/method_suffixes/sdk_module (oah/discovery/python_adapter.py's MODULE_TO_REGISTRY dispatch). imported_namespace_method_call (docs/decisions/024) is a third variant of that same suffix-matching mechanism: the receiver is the imported module/namespace identifier itself, resolved directly from the import statement -- no intervening `new X()`/`X()` construction step at all, e.g. `import cron from "node-cron"; cron.schedule(...)`. structural_pattern is driven by content_signal + detector_name instead -- a real per-domain matcher, not pure data, so the pack must also ship the code under oah/domains/<name>/detectors.py. declarative_registration (a JSX element or route-object array, e.g. React Router's <Route path=...>/createBrowserRouter) and global_unimported_callee (a bare call with no import to anchor on, e.g. fetch(...)) are both real, corpus-verified TypeScript detector shapes (SP12, docs/decisions/013) with no Python-adapter or oah/ implementation yet -- that promotion is E11-TS's job. decorator_registration remains NOT implemented by any adapter and not corpus-verified by any spike -- SP12 corrected the earlier assumption that it was the web-framework gap that mattered most; it may still be a real gap for other frameworks, just not evidenced yet.

content_signal.description: Data for detector_shape: structural_pattern. Names the comparison the adapter's structural matcher looks for -- e.g. `<expr>.type == "tool_use"` is attribute_path: ["type"], equals_value: "tool_use".

detector_name.description: Name of the function under oah/domains/<name>/detectors.py the adapter dispatches to for a structural_pattern registry entry. Required when detector_shape is structural_pattern.

emits_kind.description: surface_kind this detector produces, when a structural_pattern detector's result differs from this entry's own surface_kind (kept separate because a structural match emits independently of any resolved SDK module). Omitted means use surface_kind.

confidence_note.description: Stated, not hidden: how this registry's shape was grounded (real corpus fixture vs SDK docs), same discipline as the livekit registry's note in registry.py.

lenses.description: Replaces LENS_TO_POINT_KIND plus the four duplicated lens_fns dicts in oah/cli.py and the closed lens enum at design_fragment.schema.json:11.

target_kinds.description: Point kinds this lens designs for. null means cross-cutting -- every point, whatever its kind (today's LENS_TO_POINT_KIND['tracing'] = None).

emits.description: Artifact types this lens produces. Every lens emits design_fragment; a lens may emit more than one artifact type (design_lens() returns {artifact_type: parsed} keyed by these names) -- e.g. a future slo lens emitting design_fragment and slo_spec together, since an SLO specification is not expressible as a list of event attributes.

reused_from.description: Name of the pack this lens is reused from unchanged. Proof of the pipeline-core/domain-pack split: a lens listed here must run against this pack's points with no edit to its SKILL.md.

semconv_namespaces.description: Replaces the otel_genai literal in design_fragment.schema.json:40, event_schema.schema.json:24, oah/design/gates.py and oah/design/event_schema.py. Stability lives per namespace here and per attribute on the signal -- event_schema.schema.json's old claim that upstream attributes are 'currently always development' is true of gen_ai.* and false of http.*.

stability.description: OTel's stability stages (including the intermediate 'release_candidate' rung some namespaces use, e.g. rpc.* per docs/decisions/012) plus 'unknown' for a namespace whose maturity this project has not verified against primary sources.

pin.description: Version or commit SHA the pack targets. A namespace with no tagged releases pins a commit, as the GenAI conventions must.

schema_url.description: OTel schema URL if the namespace publishes one. Absent means no automatic version translation is available and a versioned internal rename table is required instead.

event_types.description: Extends the S8 DTO event_type enum (implementation_dto.schema.json:44), which was GenAI-shaped before extraction (generation, retrieval_span, tool_span, ...).

attribute_kind_values.description: Valid values for a design_fragment signal's maps_to.kind (design_fragment.schema.json:40) -- replaces the closed ('otel_genai', 'oah_extension') tuple hardcoded in oah/design/gates.py's gate 4 and the two named summary-count keys in oah/design/event_schema.py. Deliberately separate from semconv_namespaces: this is the flat discriminator vocabulary a signal's maps_to.kind is checked against, not the namespace list itself -- a pack with several semconv namespaces still only needs as many attribute_kind_values as it actually uses as a maps_to.kind discriminator (today's genai pack: exactly ['otel_genai', 'oah_extension']).

advisory_contradiction_pairs.description: Lexicon for the advisory gate at oah/design/gates.py, whose word pairs were drawn from the pii-governance/retrieval vocabulary before extraction. Warning severity, so a pack with an empty list loses a hint, not a gate.

gates.description: Names of S5 gates this pack adds on top of the domain-neutral ten. Eight of the current ten need no change; see docs/decisions/011.

auto_instrumentation_baseline.description: What the ecosystem already emits for this domain without any source edit. Core uses it to refuse to generate a DTO whose only effect is to re-emit a signal auto-instrumentation already provides.

caveat.description: Condition under which the baseline does NOT hold.
